title: Volcano plot of 120 genes with three standout hits
what: top hit CXCL10 log2 fold change (~3.42), linear fold (~10.7x), or -log10(p) (~9.15)

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: CXCL10 is the strongest hit (log2 FC = +3.42, ~10.7x, -log10 p = 9.15), alongside ISG15 and COL1A1.

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; all three hits sit far above the adjusted p < 0.01 (-log10 p >= 2.0) and |log2 FC| >= 1.5 thresholds.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Two interferon genes (CXCL10, ISG15) are strongly upregulated while matrix gene COL1A1 is downregulated (log2 FC = -2.61).
